researchResults.title: Teradyne invests in Bright Machines to bring robotics to AI infrastructure manufacturing
researchResults.description:
The companies plan to integrate Teradyne robotics and test technologies with the Bright Machines manufacturing platform. 

The post Teradyne invests in Bright Machines to bring robotics to AI infrastructure manufacturing appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: How robotics and physical AI can responsibly tackle key physical security challenges
researchResults.description:
Cyber and physical security threats are rapidly evolving, but robotics and AI can evolve to meet them, writes a columnist.

The post How robotics and physical AI can responsibly tackle key physical security challenges appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: FCC robot restrictions could accelerate shift to local AI
researchResults.description:
Companies deploying physical AI today need to decide which AI workloads belong on the robot, what can remain in the cloud, and whether the underlying technology stack can meet rising expectations for security, safety, and supply-chain transparency.

The post FCC robot restrictions could accelerate shift to local AI appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: The physical AI race will be won in the patent office
researchResults.description:
Patent protection is important for robotics startups, but they should be strategic in determining what IP is important, says Lightbringer.

The post The physical AI race will be won in the patent office appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Inside Omron’s next-generation LD mobile robots
researchResults.description:
In mobile robotics, software, safety, and fleet management are becoming just as important as the robot itself, according to an OMROM project manager.

The post Inside Omron’s next-generation LD mobile robots appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
researchResults.description: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

researchResults.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
researchResults.description: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

researchResults.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
researchResults.description: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

researchResults.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
researchResults.description: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

researchResults.title: Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era
researchResults.description: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.
